episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: "A new world" -- After going on a rampage with her partner-in-crime, The Joker, Harley Quinn is sent straight to Belle Reve Penitentiary.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Harley Quinn, Deadshot, Peacemaker, Clayface and King Shark find themselves in a new world of swords and sorcery, known as an "ISEKAI."

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Harley Quinn and the Suicide Squad strike a deal with Queen Aldora of the Kingdom to deactivate the bombs in their necks.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: The war between the Kingdom and the Empire has been raging for decades. Hoping to end the carnage, Princess Fione enlists Harley and her team's help.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Taking on Ratcatcher's army of beasts turns out to be a piece of cake for the Suicide Squad.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Harley and the Suicide Squad triumphantly return from dragon-slaying when they find a blazing fortress and a heartbreaking defeat.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: To stop the Suicide Squad from resetting their bombs, Thinker has his elf army build a fortress near the gate.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Back in the royal capital after their epic triumph, the Suicide Squad are in for a rude awakening.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: The shocking truth about the Undead King is revealed!

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Things look dire when Lich's undead army rolls in and starts wrecking the Kingdom.
